target.body: Adds a terse Releasing section to AGENTS.md capturing the pitfalls that broke the 0.39.0 cut: the tag annotation must be the bare version, every version-carrying file must be bumped (changelog + worker/package.json + both worker/package-lock.json root entries), the producer needs a merged authorize-source record, and the producer must run credential-free. Points at docs/RELEASING.md as the authority.
